correctness.rationale: The LCF graph has 18 vertices, 27 edges and diameter four. Exact checker generates all scale-two faces (18,81,108,18) and a 99-pair full acyclic Morse matching with one vertex and 26 two-cells; its Hasse test topologically sorts all 225 faces across 558 cover relations, establishing the integral wedge. Scale three is exactly a join of six isolated three-point sets, giving a torsion-free wedge of 64 five-spheres and an integral signed tensor homology module. All 216 distance-preserving graph automorphisms are enumerated; signed Lefschetz traces are independently compared with the join character for each group element. Character averages are (0,0,1) at scales 1,2,3. Real nonnegative thresholds and all fields follow from integral-distance filtration and rational finite-group transfer.

value.rationale: A natural canonical symmetric 18-vertex distance-regular graph has all-scale integral Rips homotopy determined, including sharp switches from 10 circles to 26 two-spheres to 64 five-spheres and a structural six-triple interpretation. The full automorphism character yields a new quotient phenomenon: scale two has no positive rational quotient homology, whereas scale three retains a degree-five invariant, invisible to unquotiented Betti numbers. Complete finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or trivial reparameterization; no universal family or downstream theorem is asserted.
